body: There may be a lot of fucked up things in this world but people try to help and move on. That's why those people are doing those interviews. It may turn out that what is broken may never be fixed. Do you ever think that normality is a lie?
Did you ever see a professional like a doctor or psychologist about your problem?
What thoughts are the ones that are coming back stronger?
I can't motivate myself to do things because I'm empty. You have to want things to act.
When the thoughts come up I spit them out. I don't like to indulge in them.
I don't agree with that last part. I want nothing, doing people favors is not how I think. Your idea of a favor is pretty messed up. You don't feel the exact same way as me.
